name: structure-viewer
description: Native atomic structure and trajectory viewer with periodic geometry, atom following, editing, and PNG/JPEG/PDF snapshots.

interface.shortDescription: 原子结构与轨迹查看、编辑
interface.longDescription: Open XYZ, extxyz, ASE traj and VASP structures in the Codex side panel. Includes multiview navigation, hydrogen bonds, display wrapping, atom following and snapshots. Bare POSCAR/CONTCAR/XDATCAR files can be selected with the local Open button.
